toegepas.voor: Jy gaan elke dag skool toe en
toegepas.na: Jy gaan elke dag skool toe, en
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two main clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma under AWS 2017; the protected wording after it is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Jy gaan' / 'niemand doen') joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adds the required AWS comma and leaves the protected wording 'niemand doen jou 'n guns nie' intact.

toegepas.voor: Die Grondwet waarborg daardie basiese onderwys vir elke kind
toegepas.na: Die Grondwet waarborg elke kind se reg op basiese onderwys
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daardie' points back to nothing named, and the next sentence's 'sulke regte' needs a right to refer to; this states the same guarantee more naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie basiese onderwys' points back only loosely, and the next sentence's 'sulke regte' has no right to refer to.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the right gives 'sulke regte' its antecedent and states the same constitutional guarantee more naturally, without adding a new claim.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Daarin' clearly means inside the Handves van Regte; 'Daar' is vague.
toegepas.fout: 'Daar staan' is vague and can read as a loose 'there is' rather than 'in it'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarin' ties the sentence clearly to the Handves van Regte with no change of meaning.

toegepas.voor: eerbiedig en beskerm, en die onderwys verskaf
toegepas.na: eerbiedig en beskerm, en hy moet die onderwys verskaf
toegepas.rede_vinder: The comma before 'en' wrongly splits one sentence sharing a subject; giving the second part its own subject and verb makes the AWS comma correct and avoids a run of 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'en' between two parts of one sentence that share a subject, against AWS 2017.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Giving the second part its own subject and verb makes the comma correct and breaks the run of 'en' while the state's three duties stay the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Two main clauses, each with subject 'jy' and its own verb, joined by 'en' take a comma under AWS 2017.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses, each with subject 'jy' and its own verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adds the required AWS comma; nothing else changes.

toegepas.na: almal wat laer af daaruit skep
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'skep' needs to say what is scooped from; 'daaruit' completes it without repeating 'water'.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'skep' makes a Grade 6 reader stumble, because its commonest sense is 'create', not 'scoop'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daaruit skep' makes clear that people downstream scoop water from the stream, and adds nothing else.

toegepas.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
toegepas.voor: kom die Nasionale Vergadering uit daardie stemme
toegepas.na: word die Nasionale Vergadering met daardie stemme gekies
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kom ... uit daardie stemme' is wooden; 'word ... gekies' is natural and matches the glossary entry's 'kies'.
toegepas.fout: 'kom die Nasionale Vergadering uit daardie stemme' is wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'word ... met daardie stemme gekies' is natural Afrikaans, says that the voters' votes elect the body, matches the glossary's 'kies' and keeps the protected name.

toegepas.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
toegepas.voor: Sy lede kies dan die President
toegepas.na: Die lede van die Nasionale Vergadering kies dan die President
toegepas.rede_vinder: After three sentences where 'Sy' means the voter, 'Sy lede' briefly reads as 'she'; naming the body removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: After three sentences in which 'sy' is the voter, a capitalised 'Sy lede' can be read as 'her members'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the body removes a real ambiguity in reference, and the protected name is used unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: One throws rubbish into a bin rather than 'keeps' it there, and 'vullisdrom' is clearer than a bare 'drom'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'jou vullis in 'n drom te hou' reads well and carries the sense of keeping rubbish contained, while the proposal swaps the verb, repeats 'vullis' and creates a 'gooi ... Gooi' echo with the next sentence.

laat_vaar.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vir almal kies' can read as 'chooses everyone'; 'namens almal' clearly means on everyone's behalf.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The preposition swap moves the meaning: 'vir almal kies' means making the choice that binds everyone, while 'namens almal' makes the voters formal representatives of the non-voters.
